acceptance: The CLI is stdlib-only and is invokable with python -m tools.governance_v2.
issue sync and issue verify validate the frozen TaskContract and emit machine-readable JSON with the documented exit mapping.
migration build and migration verify produce and validate complete local PR #2 commit/path matrices without TODO, UNKNOWN, or REVIEW classifications.
bootstrap snapshot and bootstrap plan are read-only and emit machine-readable JSON.
Issue writes are rejected unless an explicit --confirm-write flag is present; the CLI does not create GOV-V2-BOOTSTRAP.
Unit tests cover canonical digests, event-chain integrity, fork detection, migration matrix validation, exit codes, and write confirmation.
forbidden_paths: v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 tags or releases
remote branch protection, rulesets, releases, tags, and issue writes except the explicit bootstrap issue
credentials, tokens, secrets, and local runtime caches
goal: Establish the v2 governance control plane and implement the bounded Stage 0 CLI without authorizing the CLI to create its own bootstrap contract.
